sources.entry: Quick Recorder - A lightweight and high-performance screen recorder for macOS [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/lihaoyun6/QuickRecorder) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: QuickRecorder
summary.one_liner: QuickRecorder is a lightweight, open-source screen recorder for macOS built on Apple's ScreenCapture Kit API.
use_cases: Recording the full screen, a window or a single app on a Mac
Capturing system sound without installing audio drivers
Making presenter-style videos with a camera overlay
Recording a Mac and an iPhone or iPad at the same time
summary.what_it_does: QuickRecorder records screens, windows, and individual apps on macOS. It is built on Apple's ScreenCapture Kit API. It can record system sound from apps without third-party audio drivers, but only on macOS 13 and later. On macOS 14 it offers a "Presenter Overlay" that cuts out the camera feed and places it over the recording; macOS 12 and 13 only get a standard camera floating window. It can also record a Mac and an iPhone or iPad together, though that option is not available in single-window recording mode.
notable: Open source and built on Apple's ScreenCapture Kit API
Driverless system audio capture on macOS 13+
Presenter Overlay with background-removed camera on macOS 14
Can record Mac and iOS devices simultaneously
caveats: Some features need macOS 13 or macOS 14; the camera overlay is limited on macOS 12 and 13
Older builds may stop running because the developer's free certificate expired; users must install the latest version or override Malware Protection
